prompts.roomDay: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual illustrated room background for a companion app, NOT a UI mockup. Create a beautiful lived-in but uncluttered small student's online room, painterly high-quality anime background, fine timber grain and linen textures, soft natural daytime light. Landscape 3:2. Fixed eye-level wide interior composition: a wooden study desk at left beneath tall shelving, large window center-left overlooking ordinary soft-focus Chengdu neighborhood roofs (no landmarks), a comfortable muted sage fabric reading chair center, low EMPTY cabinet and extra simple seat on right. Calm ivory plaster walls with a broad clean upper wall, oak floor, airy and grounded atmosphere, no heavy gold filter. Objects built into room architecture only. Desk and shelves and cabinet surfaces empty enough for future interactive objects. NO people, books, desk lamps, laptop, loose objects, deer plushies, food, drinks, words, UI, watermark. Single coherent room, no panels or collage. Keep entire room corners and furniture visible with a generous center floor foreground.
prompts.focus: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: new in-app illustrated life scene, landscape 4:3. Input 1 is identity and painterly anime style reference only. Keep exactly Luya's recognizable face, long wavy chestnut hair, brown eyes, natural bangs, single small deer hair clip, ivory cable knit cardigan and muted dusty rose inner top. New scene: she is working on a small computer prototype at a modest oak desk in her student room, viewed at seated eye height in a natural three-quarter angle. Looking at laptop and paper, slightly thoughtful brow, one hand on laptop and other holding pencil over notebook, anatomically correct natural hands. Medium-wide seated composition, entire head, both hands and working surface visible, person central and not cropped by frame. Wears comfortable long trousers. Ivory plaster, oak shelving, blurred ordinary neighborhood window, restrained sage accents; soft neutral daylight. Sophisticated detailed warm anime painting matching reference face rendering. Her life has focus and agency. No reaching at viewer, no eye contact, no food/drinks/blankets, no romantic invitation, no stuffed deer, no extra jewelry motifs, no readable text/logos/code, no UI, no watermark. One coherent illustration, not a design sheet.
prompts.roomNight: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: this exact room image. Make a matching nighttime version for the same companion app background. Change ONLY lighting/time: window outside dark blue evening with a few soft distant lit windows, interior softly readable via warm ambient ceiling light, subtle shadows. Preserve exact camera, crop, EVERY architectural line, same empty furniture, same materials, same houseplants. Keep scene clear and detailed, do not darken to near black. Do not add lamps or books or people or new furniture. Same landscape 3:2 dimensions. No text/UI/watermark.
prompts.reading: Use case: identity-preserve. New in-app illustration landscape 4:3. Input1 is Luya original identity, Input2 is approved new style and clothing reference. Same young adult college student Luya, same recognizable face, long wavy chestnut hair, brown eyes and natural bangs, single small deer hairclip, ivory knit cardigan with dusty rose inner top, comfortable muted trousers. A quiet candid moment sitting in a sage linen armchair beside an oak shelf and window in her modest student room, an open literary book on her lap and a pencil resting between fingers, absorbed downward thoughtful gaze, soft small smile, both hands naturally visible. Eye-level medium-wide 3/4 portrait. Head, torso, hands, book and knees all inside frame. Fine painterly anime rendering matching ref2, calm neutral daylight, soft cream and oak and muted sage, readable facial features. No direct eye contact, reaching at viewer, food/drinks, fake printed text, UI, watermarks, collage. Book pages have only delicate abstract unrecognizable strokes. No new character, no sexualized angle.
